title: Burlesque Hall of Fame

services.name: Burlesque Classes
services.desc: The Burlesque Hall of Fame’s School of Striptease offers burlesque classes for the hobbyist, the novice, and established performers of all levels. Our classes are guided by the principle that “All bodies are burlesque bodies”, with a commitment to the comfort and empowerment of our students. Furthermore, we welcome all ages (over 18), ethnicities, body types, levels of physical ability, and levels of personal comfort. Learn the art of burlesque from the industry’s top performers of today and yesteryear! “The largest benefit by far is my increased self esteem. These classes have created a new way of seeing myself. services.name: Paula The Swedish Housewife
services.desc: Meet Paula The Swedish Housewife, one of our two 2026 Sassy Lassy award recipients! The Sassy Lassy is awarded annually to performers, producers, and others in the burlesque community who have made an outsized contribution to the perpetuation of burlesque in the modern era, and few have made as big a contribution as Paula has. Paula The Swedish Housewife was part of the Seattle burlesque, cabaret, and performance art scene as producer and personality for nearly 30 years between 1986 to 2015. Called “the Queen Bee of Seattle Burlesque” The Village Voice, named as one of the “Best Reasons to Live in Seattle” by Seattle Metropolitan Magazine and “ my gateway drug to Burlesque” by El Vez.
